headline: Exchange Intake Rises To 1,029.9 Million Dollars From 716.8 Million
narrative: Clean-asset intake across 79 venues rose to 1,029.9 million dollars, 0.3778 percent of the 272.6 billion dollars held there excluding each venue's own token, from 716.8 million dollars and 0.2637 percent in the prior reading. Binance took in 836.1 million dollars, up from 552.8 million dollars, while OKX took in 190.6 million dollars, Gate took in 176.8 million dollars, Crypto.com posted a 67.6 million dollar outflow, and Bybit posted a 44.7 million dollar outflow. The pipe measures the change in dollars held on the venues excluding each exchange's own token, so the larger positive total means more money arrived than in the prior reading, and Binance was the largest arrival.
author: jordan
